codeReview.summary: The implementation matches the feature contract: signed-out revisits to token-stripped public booking detail URLs now reconstruct the canonical /bookings/recover entrypoint when a valid recovery cookie still exists, and they fall back to the canonical recovery sign-in handoff when booking lookup or token minting cannot proceed.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The recovery continuity flow and dev harness both depend on SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET, but the shared environment notes still do not document that prerequisite for future reviewers/validators exercising booking recovery continuity.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/app/(public)/bookings/[bookingId]/page.tsx:53-64 gates continuation token minting on SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET and src/app/(public)/dev/booking-recovery/page.tsx:34-48 only generates a live recovery link when that secret is present, while .factory/library/environment.md omits this recovery-specific env requirement.

summary: Reviewed handoff, transcript skeleton, commit 2b399135, and related recovery routes/helpers. The feature satisfies the continuity contract with no blocking or non-blocking code issues found; only the previously noted shared environment-documentation gap remains.
